items.title: The Man Behind the Berny Algorithm: 50 Years of Computational Chemistry with Berny Schlegel
items.summary:
H. Bernhard "Berny" Schlegel, Distinguished Professor of Chemistry at Wayne State University, reflects on more than five decades of computational chemistry, from punch cards and mainframe computers to today's AI-assisted tools. This conversation traces his work with Nobel laureate John Pople, the origin story behind the "Berny" optimization algorithm and how Wolfram Language became central to his research for symbolic calculations, data visualization and molecular simulations. He also digs into strong-field chemistry, femtosecond laser experiments, and his advice for the next generation of scientists.

#computationalchemistry #chemistry #pople #wolfram #Gaussian #Mathematica

This approach helps maintain consistency and focus on what truly matters.
